frase: Finds jobs in public sources and shows everything in a panel on your computer.
ferramentas.navegador_frase: For LinkedIn and other sites you sign in to. You can get it later in Settings › Tools.
falha.arquivo: A file in the installer is not the expected one. Nothing was installed.
falha.arquivo_oque: Download the installer again from the joBot page.
falha.espaco: Not enough disk space. What the installation did was undone.
falha.espaco_oque: Free up some space and try again.
falha.prova: The check of the installed joBot failed. Nothing was installed.
falha.prova_oque: Try again. If it happens again, download the installer again from the joBot page.
falha.outro: The installation did not finish. What it did was undone.
falha.outro_oque: Try again. If it happens again, download the installer again from the joBot page.
incompleto.texto: Files the installation needs are missing. Download the installer again from the joBot page.
alerta.texto: What was done will be undone.
